info.title: Ethereum JSON-RPC (excerpt)
info.description: Three read-only methods from https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis, which any public Ethereum node answers.

methods.name: eth_chainId
methods.summary: Returns the chain ID of the current network.

methods.name: eth_blockNumber
methods.summary: Returns the number of the most recent block.

methods.name: eth_getBalance
methods.summary: Returns the balance of the account of a given address, in wei.

schema.description: A block number in hex, or latest, earliest, pending, safe or finalized.
